title: Code and analysis records for: Transcriptomic Hidden Oestrogen-Receptor Activity in ER-Negative Breast Cancer Is Technically Reproducible but Depends on Definition and Cohort
description: Analysis code, SHA-256-hashed internal analysis plan (25 October 2026), amendments A1–A4, deviations log, results files and figures for a secondary analysis of public data (GEO GSE96058, GSE40049, GSE38167, GSE337499, GSE337500; external cohort GSE25066) on the reproducibility, definition dependence, cohort dependence and composition of transcriptomic hidden ER activity calls in IHC ER-negative breast cancer.
